# netbox_asn (Data Source)

Retrieves a single asn from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_asn" "asn_1" {
  asn = "1111"
  tag = "tag-1"
}

data "netbox_asn" "asn_2" {
  tag    = "tag-1"
  tag__n = "tag-2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `asn` (String) The AS number. At least one of `asn` or `tag` must be given.
- `tag` (String) Tag to include in the data source filter (must match the tag's slug). At least one of `asn` or `tag` must be given.
- `tag__n` (String) Tag to exclude from the data source filter (must match the tag's slug).
Refer to [Netbox's documentation](https://demo.netbox.dev/static/docs/rest-api/filtering/#lookup-expressions)
for more information on available lookup expressions.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the asn.
- `created` (String) When the asn was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the asn, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the asn.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the asn.
- `last_updated` (String) When the asn was last changed.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the asn.
- `provider_count` (Number) The number of provider of the asn.
- `rir_id` (Number) The ID of the rir associated with the asn.
- `role_id` (Number) The ID of the role associated with the asn.
- `site_count` (Number) The number of site of the asn.
- `sites` (List of Number) The IDs of the sites of the asn.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant associated with the asn.
